subject: Discovery follow-up: reschedule demo / tighter confirmation
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery follow-up: demo / next steps

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning to walk through Acme's priorities — appreciated the context on ingestion latency and the multi-tenant routing requirements. Quick recap from my side: 

- Goal: Reduce inference latency on short prompt paths (chat UI) and support a secure, private deployment option for regulated data.
- Current constraints: 2k concurrent users, 99th pct latency target under 300ms, compliance audit later this quarter.
- Success metrics: latency <300ms 99th, predictable cost per 1k requests, and SOC2 evidence for audit.

Next step: technical demo + deeper infra discussion so Rafael (our solutions architect) can cover deployment patterns and quantization options. Can you do one of these slots?

- Wed, Jun 2 — 11:00-11:45 AM PDT
- Thu, Jun 3 — 9:00-9:45 AM PDT

If either works, I'll send a calendar invite and include Rafael. I'm attaching my notes from today and a short mutual action plan to make sure we cover procurement and security items during the demo.

Attachments: discovery-notes.pdf, mutual-action-plan.pdf

Thanks — if neither works, send a couple of windows and I'll tighten confirmation on my side.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(415) 555-0128

Hi Marissa,

Really sorry — we had an internal all-hands pop up so I missed our call this morning. Appreciate the notes and definitely interested in the demo. The two slots you proposed look good in general but I have a leadership sync during the Thu 9am slot.

Can you do any of these instead?
- Wed, Jun 2 — 2:00-2:45 PM PDT
- Fri, Jun 4 — 10:00-10:45 AM PDT

Also, I'd like to include Olivia Park (ops) and our head of infra — I'll loop them in once we lock a time.

Thanks,
Alex

alex.johnson@acmeai.com
